svg.desc: Log-log roofline for a T4 in fp32: attainable throughput rises with arithmetic intensity along the memory-bandwidth roof until the ridge point at about 25 FLOP per byte, then stays flat at the 8.1 TFLOP/s compute peak. An elementwise add (intensity 1/12) and LayerNorm sit on the memory-bound slope; a 1024 by 1024 matmul (intensity about 170) is compute-bound.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attainable FLOP/s = min(peak, arithmetic intensity × memory bandwidth). T4, fp32.
